handoff_instructions: M2-T16 (Voice adapter (Vapi)) implemented in one step. Added packages/integrations/src/adapters/vapi-voice-provider.ts: VapiVoiceProvider implementing the existing VoiceProvider interface (packages/integrations/src/providers/voice-provider.ts) using fetch with Bearer auth against the Vapi REST API (POST /phone-number for createInboundRoute, POST /call for initiateOutboundCall, POST /call/{id}/control for transferCall). Maps Vapi call statuses (queued/ringing/in-progress/forwarding/ended) to domain statuses. initiateOutboundCall and transferCall are idempotent via an in-memory map keyed by organizationId+idempotencyKey. verifyWebhookSignature fails closed and does a constant-time compare of the `x-vapi-secret` header against the configured shared secret (Vapi echoes back a configured secret rather than HMAC-signing the body). ingestWebhook normalizes a Vapi server message and throws if message.call.id is missing. Added packages/integrations/test/vapi-voice-provider.test.ts covering request shape/auth/body for all three REST calls, status mapping, idempotency (including cross-org), non-2xx handling for call creation and transfer, signature verification (valid/wrong-secret/missing), and webhook ingestion (normalize + missing-id throw). Exported the new adapter from packages/integrations/src/index.ts. No DB tables/RLS involved (integration-adapter-only task, no persistence layer touched, no AI prompts involved). Ran pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test at repo root: all pass (integrations: 4 files/36 tests passed; full repo: all green). Only packages/integrations/src/adapters/vapi-voice-provider.ts (new), packages/integrations/test/vapi-voice-provider.test.ts (new), and packages/integrations/src/index.ts (+1 export line) were touched. Next: ChatGPT review of M2-T16; if approved, M2-T17 is next per blueprint.json.
